label: Grandstream GWN7802
description: Grandstream GWN7802 - 20-port Layer 2+ managed switch: 16x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 and 4x 1G SFP uplinks, no PoE. 40 Gbps switching capacity, 20 Gbps non-blocking, 29.76 Mpps, 4.1 Mb packet buffer, fanless 1U 440 mm rack/desktop case.

fabric.note: Datasheet Switching Capability 40 Gbps, Total non-blocking throughput 20 Gbps, forwarding rate 29.76 Mpps.

notes: Datasheet: 16 Gigabit Ethernet ports, 4x 1G SFP, 1 console, integrated power supply 30 W, fanless (the GWN7802P is the model with 1 fan). 440 x 200 x 44 mm, 2.6 kg. Console 115200 8-N-1 into the CLI. Layer 2+ only, no static routing on this SKU.
